chunk:
deviations:
  - "Field names use camelCase (not OAGIS PascalCase) — DataWeave convention"
  - "status enum simplified to ACTIVE/INACTIVE/SUSPENDED/CHURNED (OAGIS uses Status/Code free text)"
  - "contacts[] flattened from OAGIS Contact/ContactName/PersonName hierarchy"
  - "addresses split into billing/shipping/hq (OAGIS uses Address[] with AddressTypeCd)"

description: |
  Canonical customer/account entity schema across all client integrations.
  Maps from: Salesforce Account, NetSuite Customer, Dynamics 365 Account, HubSpot Company.
  Maps to: any target CRM, ERP, or service system.
  OAGIS alignment: CustomerPartyType — key fields customerId→CustomerID, name→OrganizationName,
  contacts→Contact[], addresses→Address[].

properties:
  customerId:
    type: string
    description: Canonical customer identifier
    example: "ACCT-001234"

  externalIds:
    type: object
    description: Source system identifiers
    properties:
      salesforceAccountId: { type: string, example: "0010000001234" }
      netsuiteInternalId:  { type: string, example: "5678" }
      erpCustomerNumber:   { type: string, example: "CUST-0001" }
      hubspotCompanyId:    { type: string, example: "12345678" }

  name:
    type: string
    description: Legal entity name
    example: "Acme Corp"

  type:
    type: string
    enum: [PROSPECT, CUSTOMER, PARTNER, RESELLER, INTERNAL]

  status:
    type: string
    enum: [ACTIVE, INACTIVE, SUSPENDED, CHURNED]

  segment:
    type: string
    enum: [ENTERPRISE, MID_MARKET, SMB, STARTUP]
    description: Customer tier for routing and prioritisation

  industry:
    type: string
    description: SIC/NAICS industry classification or free text

  contacts:
    type: array
    items:
      $ref: '#/Contact'

  addresses:
    type: object
    properties:
      billing:  { $ref: '#/Address' }
      shipping: { $ref: '#/Address' }
      hq:       { $ref: '#/Address' }

  financial:
    $ref: '#/CustomerFinancial'

  relationships:
    type: object
    properties:
      parentCustomerId: { type: string, description: "Parent account for hierarchies" }
      ownerId:          { type: string, description: "Canonical owner/rep identifier" }
      accountManagerId: { type: string }

  time
